title: Upay & Proximo payment platforms
summary: Designed, built and integrated Upay App, Upay Business and Proximo with financial partners: money transfer, top-up and payments.
context: ATPS SA, based in Dakar, runs money transfer, top-up and payment services. These services depend on exchanges with several financial partners, each with its own interfaces.
challenge: Ship new payment platforms for consumers (Upay App), businesses (Upay Business) and the local agent network (Proximo), while evolving the platforms already in production without interrupting financial flows.

approach.title: Partner integration
approach.detail: Designed and built the integrations with financial partners for money transfer, top-up and payment offerings.

approach.title: Angular front end, Spring Boot back end
approach.detail: Angular interfaces and Spring Boot services exposed over REST, alongside the existing SOAP services.

approach.title: Continuous delivery
approach.detail: GitLab CI pipelines and Docker containers to ship changes to production platforms repeatably.

outcomes: Three payment platforms shipped: Upay App, Upay Business and Proximo
Money transfer, top-up and payment offerings integrated with financial partners
Existing platforms maintained and extended for three years

title: Migrating SOAP web services to REST
summary: Migrated SOAP web services to REST APIs for money transfer, top-up and payment offerings.
context: Money transfer, top-up and payment offerings relied on SOAP web services, which were heavier to evolve and to consume from web and mobile applications.
challenge: Modernise the interfaces of services used in production by financial offerings, without breaking existing consumers.

approach.title: REST contracts
approach.detail: Redefined the money transfer, top-up and payment services as REST APIs.

approach.title: Coexistence
approach.detail: Progressive migration: SOAP and REST services coexist while consumers switch over.

approach.title: Continuous integration
approach.detail: Automated builds and deployments with GitLab CI and Docker.

outcomes: Money transfer, top-up and payment offerings exposed over REST
API foundation reused by the new Upay and Proximo platforms

title: Large file imports on a multi-tenant SaaS
role: Full Stack Developer, remote from Senegal
summary: Optimised large file imports on a multi-tenant SaaS platform for project monitoring and evaluation, built in Quebec City.
context: DevAlto builds a multi-tenant SaaS platform for project monitoring and evaluation (M&E). Each client organisation imports its data, sometimes as very large files.
challenge: Make large file imports reliable and fast on a platform shared by many organisations, within a microservices architecture.

approach.title: Import optimisation
approach.detail: Reviewed and optimised the import pipeline for large files.

approach.title: Architecture
approach.detail: Worked within a microservices architecture designed with DDD and Clean Architecture.

approach.title: Quality
approach.detail: Code reviews, QA and end-to-end tests with Selenium, continuous integration with GitHub Actions.

outcomes: Large file imports optimised on the production platform
Nearly three years of remote collaboration with a Quebec-based team

title: White-label money transfer platform
summary: Designed and built a white-label money transfer platform, working closely with business teams.
context: Money Express, part of the Chaka Group, provides money transfer services. A white-label platform lets partners offer the service under their own brand.
challenge: Design a single platform, customisable per brand, from business requirements that still had to be framed.

approach.title: Framing with the business
approach.detail: Worked closely with business teams to frame the requirements.

approach.title: Design and development
approach.detail: Platform built in PHP with an AngularJS front end.

approach.title: Evolution
approach.detail: Evolved the existing platforms in parallel.

outcomes: White-label money transfer platform designed and built
First FinTech experience, the foundation for the payment projects that followed
